title: [SEC3] Strengthen SPA route detection in static_handler
description: Line 20 in crates/kithd/src/static_files.rs uses '\!path.contains(".")' as a heuristic to detect SPA fallback routes. This is overly broad: it would incorrectly route versioned API endpoints (e.g., /api/v1.0/something) or other paths containing dots. Better approach: enumerate safe static file extensions (.js, .css, .html, .png, .svg, .ico, .json, .wasm, .map) and check file extension explicitly, or check against known file patterns from rust_embed.
